working_definition: Tm9b is one of two transcriptomic subtypes (Tm9a, Tm9b) of Tm9 neurons newly distinguished in the Kurmangaliyev 2020 optic-lobe atlas (GSE156455). It is a narrow-field transmedullary cholinergic interneuron with dendritic input in medulla layers M2/M3 and axon output in lobula layer 1. Within this atlas the subtype is defined by expression of Wnt4 (ventral-specific, mutually exclusive with Wnt10 in Tm9a) and restriction of its axon terminals to the ventral half of the lobula.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the ventral half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt4 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).

justification: FBbt:00058234 'transmedullary neuron Tm9b' was defined directly from Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, the same publication as this atlas. Its two defining criteria — ventral-half lobula targeting and Wnt4 expression — are identical to the cluster definition. The a/b subtype nomenclature in FBbt for Tm9 neurons originates from this dataset, so the label correspondence is not coincidental but is derived from the same primary source. This is therefore a confident exact match. Unlike the Dm3a/b case (where FBbt subtypes were defined by a later study with independent morphological criteria), here no unresolved cross-modality correspondence exists.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that has most of its dendritic arborization in medulla layers M2 and M3, with some extensions into M1, M4 and M5 (Gao et al., 2008; Ting et al., 2014), and presynapses in M3 (Gao et al., 2008). Its axon follows the posterior edge of its cognate medulla column (Ting et al., 2014), then crosses in the second optic chiasma and terminates in lobula layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Ting et al., 2014), where it outputs to T5 neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2014). It is a cholinergic neuron (Gao et al., 2008; Shinomiya et al., 2014). It expresses the transcription factor sim (Ozel et al., 2021). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent term; accurately describes the base Tm9 identity but does not capture the Wnt4/ventral-lobula subtype distinction. Rejected in favour of the more specific FBbt:00058234 which is a confirmed exact match.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the dorsal half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt10 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Sibling subtype defined from the same paper; targets the dorsal half of the lobula and expresses Wnt10, the complement of Tm9b. Included for completeness; not the correct assignment for the Wnt4/ventral cluster.

recommendation: Accept exact match to FBbt:00058234. The FBbt term was coined from this dataset with identical defining criteria (Wnt4 expression, ventral lobula targeting); no further verification is required.
